# The loop index used as a "scalar" must not be hoisted as a broadcast.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func AddIndex(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] += a[i] * int32(i)
	}
}

func MulIdx(dst, a []int32, n int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] * n
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import "simd"

func AddIndex(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] += a[i] * int32(i)
	}
}

func MulIdx(dst, a []int32, n int32) {
	_vcInt32s0 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(n)
	for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(a[_i:])
		_v1.Mul(_vcInt32s0).StorePart(dst[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func AddIndex(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] += a[i] * int32(i)
	}
}

func MulIdx(dst, a []int32, n int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] * n
	}
}
